description: This PHP class 'EmployeeReportingMethodService' provides methods for managing employee reporting relationships such as fetching immediate supervisors and subordinates, and handling assigned supervisor lists within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodService
classes.description: Service class for managing employee reporting relationships in the OrangeHRM system, including fetching supervisors and subordinates, and managing assignment lists.

methods.name: getEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmployeeReportingMethodDao instance used for accessing reporting data.

methods.name: setEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Sets the EmployeeReportingMethodDao instance, useful for dependency injection and testing.

methods.name: getImmediateSupervisorListForEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves a list of immediate supervisors for a given employee based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getImmediateSupervisorListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Returns the count of immediate supervisors matching the given filter parameters.

methods.name: getSubordinateListForEmployee
methods.description: Fetches a list of subordinates for a specific employee based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSubordinateListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Returns the count of subordinates matching the specified filter parameters.

methods.name: getAccessibleAndAvailableSupervisorsIdCombinedList
methods.description: Generates a list of supervisor IDs that are accessible and not yet assigned, by subtracting assigned IDs from accessible IDs.

methods.name: getAlreadyAssignedSupervisorsSubordinatesAndSelfIdCombinedList
methods.description: Combines lists of supervisors, subordinates, and a given employee ID into a single list of IDs.
